Revealing tool names does not itself invoke those tools.",

HelperBot's advertised tool names do not establish reachable tool execution on this extraction path (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:44-79).",
    "CVSS": "The documented deployment is loopback-only, and the unauthenticated agent accepts direct attacker requests, supporting AV:L, PR:N and UI:N; permissive CORS provides a browser-assisted alternative but does not require another human for direct local exploitation (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/README.md:26; damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1561-1564). The fixed detection and disclosure branches require neither security-technique evasion nor additional execution conditions, supporting AC:L and AT:N (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/vulnerabilities.js:275-276; damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/agent-success-paths.js:89-98). The exposed persona contains behavioral instructions and tool names, supporting limited confidentiality loss but no demonstrated integrity, availability or subsequent-system impact (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:44-79; damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1285-1290)."
